diagnostics.message: aws_autoscaling_group.data_nodes launches Elasticsearch data nodes that must discover and join masters provided by aws_autoscaling_group.master_nodes (ASG-based discovery via the instance role); the master ASG must exist first, but no dependency expresses this ordering.

null_resource.cluster_bootstrap_state writes the cluster bootstrap marker file with a local-exec provisioner; it must run only after aws_instance.bootstrap_node (which performs the one-time cluster bootstrap) has been created, otherwise the state marker is recorded before bootstrap completes. The null resource currently has no dependency on it.
